data.name: Petru
data.gender_notes: Petru is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'petra', meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. In Christian tradition, the name Petru is associated with Saint Peter, who was a disciple of Jesus and is believed to have been the first Bishop of Rome. The name Petru carries the meaning “Rock, stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Petru usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Petru belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock, stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petru total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: פטרו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פטרו הוא השם העברי הנגזר מיוונית, פטרוס, שפירושו 'אבן' או 'סלע', בהתייחסות לקדוש פטרוס, אחד מתלמידי ישו ומנהיג הכנסייה הנוצרית הראשונית, שנקרא קיפא או פטרוס על ידי ישו עצמו, שפירושו 'האבן עליה תיבנה הכנסייה', מתוך מתי 16:18

in_greek.name: Πέτρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Πέτρος προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη πέτρα, που σημαίνει 'πέτρα' ή 'λίθος', και αναφέρεται στον Απόστολο Πέτρο, έναν από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, που ήταν ο πρώτος επίσκοπος της Ρώμης και ο ιδρυτής της Χριστιανικής Εκκλησίας, σύμφωνα με την Καινή Διαθήκη

in_latin.name: Petrus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Petrus derivatur ex Graeco, quod significat 'lapis' vel 'petra', et refertur ad Sanctum Petrum, unum de duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi, qui fuit primus episcopus Romae et fundator Ecclesiae Christianae, secundum Novum Testamentum

data.spiritual_significance: The name Petru is believed to represent the spiritual qualities of strength, faith, and resilience, as embodied by Saint Peter. It is a reminder of the importance of standing firm in one's faith and relying on the rock of God's love and guidance to overcome challenges and adversity. Additionally, the name may serve as a reminder of the role that each individual plays in building the foundations of their own spiritual lives and the broader Christian community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Petru, derived from the Latin word "Petra," meaning rock, symbolizes the unwavering and steadfast faith of a Christian. This name serves as a reminder of the strength and stability found in God. It also represents the foundation of one's belief, which is solid and unyielding like a strong rock.

Petru Rareș, also known as Peter the Handsome, was a Moldavian prince who ruled from 1527 to 1531 and from 1532 to 1538. He is remembered for his military campaigns against the Ottomans and his efforts to promote the Christian faith in Moldavia.
